lines.text: Many learners say: I will meet you at there.
Better: I will meet you there.
There already means in that place.

data.wrong: I will meet you at there.
data.why: There already means in that place.

native.tip: हिंदी में “वहाँ पर” कहते हैं, इसलिए at जुड़ जाता है; अंग्रेज़ी में there अकेला काफ़ी है।
native.caption: क्या आप भी यही कहते हैं? “I will meet you at there.” 😅 सही रूप है “I will meet you there.” क्योंकि there के साथ at नहीं लगता। Ama की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “there”। इसे ज़ोर से बोलकर दोहराइए। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: Many learners add at before there, but there is enough alone.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I will meet you at there.” 😅 The right way is “I will meet you there.” This is right because there needs no at. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
